description: HTTP request parsing tests. Given a raw HTTP request string, parse into method, target, headers, and body.

tests.description: Parses a simple GET request
Parses request target with query string
Parses POST request with JSON body
tests.input:
POST /wp/v2/posts HTTP/1.1
Host: localhost
Content-Type: application/json
Content-Length: 35

{"title":"Hello","content":"World"}

tests.description: Parses DELETE request
Parses PUT request with body
Parses multiple headers

Host: localhost
Accept: application/json

tests.description: Parses PATCH request
Parses OPTIONS request
Preserves semicolon path parameters in target
Preserves percent-encoded characters in target
Preserves multiple consecutive slashes in target
Preserves double question marks in target
Preserves at-sign and brackets in target
Preserves dot segments in target
Preserves absolute-form URI as target
Preserves fragment in target
Preserves quotes in target
Parses HEAD request
Parses CONNECT request with authority-form target
Parses OPTIONS request with asterisk-form target
Parses header value with no space after colon
Bare CRLF returns needsMoreData after leading CRLF stripping
Handles HTTP/1.0 request with no headers
Handles zero Content-Length
Append after complete is a no-op
No Content-Length is allowed regardless of maxBodySize

errorTests.description: Rejects non-UTF-8 header bytes (0xFF 0xFE BOM-like)

Rejects overlong UTF-8 encoding (0xC0 0xAF for U+002F) in header value
Rejects lone continuation byte (0x80) in header value
Rejects code point above U+10FFFF (0xF4 0x90 0x80 0x80) in header value
Rejects truncated 3-byte UTF-8 sequence in header value
Rejects 0xFE byte (never valid in UTF-8) in header value
Rejects lone surrogate half (U+D800 as CESU-8) in header value
Rejects header with space before colon (request smuggling vector)

Content-Length : 0
